mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and equity performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, indicating a strong supply side, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window during tightening cycles, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth above 5% YoY, signaling strong demand, always leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and equity markets
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS growth > 5% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises by more than 50bps in a quarter and CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth remains below 2% YoY, the combined signal of monetary tightening without inflationary pressures leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 50bps in a quarter and CPIAUCSL growth < 2% YoY
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5pp in 2 months, indicating a rapidly improving labor market, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window during early-cycle expansions, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, signaling strong economic demand, always leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between GDP and equity markets
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
